purpose: CPU-only reward-driven closed-loop learning; no imitation labels and no financial deployment
optimizer: antithetic Gaussian evolution strategy with standardized paired returns, Adam
trainingSeeds: train/generation*100 + 0,1; each candidate plays both sides of each seed
trainingOpponents: initial random readout plus frozen student checkpoints every four generations; generation cycles opponent pool; never final-test opponents
selection: highest fixed-validation mean reward; final test never used for model/epoch choice
deploymentGate: CLOSED: even a research pass is not physical realism, robust opponent performance, payment verification, whole-brain or consciousness evidence
